# SUNation Energy, Inc. (SUNE) — filings read: 10-K accession 0000022701-26-000003; 10-Q accession 0000022701-26-000010; 8-K accession 0001213900-26-122794 and Exhibit 99.1
# Run time: 2026-11-21T02:29:18-05:00

# Overview

SUNation Energy, Inc. operates solar, battery-storage, and grid-services businesses in New York and Hawaii (10-k.txt:1805). The November 20, 2026, earnings release reported Q3 2026 revenue of $11.20 million, compared with $18.99 million in Q3 2025 (exhibit-99-1.txt:112). It reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $11.82 million and $9.82 million of goodwill and intangible-asset impairment charges (exhibit-99-1.txt:114; exhibit-99-1.txt:115).

# Market Positioning and Growth Outlook

Residential contract revenue declined 52% year over year in Q3 2026, while commercial revenue increased 20% (exhibit-99-1.txt:57; exhibit-99-1.txt:58). Commercial and service revenue represented approximately 33% of Q3 2026 consolidated revenue, compared with approximately 18% in Q3 2025 (exhibit-99-1.txt:58; exhibit-99-1.txt:59). Hawaii Energy Connection's battery attachment rate increased 13% year over year during the quarter (exhibit-99-1.txt:71).

The proposed Suniva merger is the principal event catalyst. Management said that it anticipated completion in Q1 2027, subject to required conditions and approvals (exhibit-99-1.txt:107). The filing does not establish that the transaction will close.

# Valuation Insights

FY 2025 revenue was $71,905,527, and FY 2025 net loss was $10,892,833 (facts.json:total_revenue; facts.json:net_income). FY 2025 operating cash flow was $954,978, and capital expenditures were $48,594, producing code-calculated free cash flow of $906,384 (facts.json:cash_from_operations; facts.json:property_equipment_additions; calculations.json:free_cash_flow).

### Required Course Claims — Code-Built Audit Block

Annual total revenue was $71.906 million (facts.json:total_revenue).
Annual revenue growth was 26.4568% (calculations.json:revenue_growth).
Annual operating income was $-1.673 million (facts.json:operating_income).
Annual operating margin was -2.3267% (calculations.json:operating_margin).
Annual net income attributable to the company was $-10.893 million (facts.json:net_income).
Annual GAAP diluted EPS was $-4.38 (facts.json:diluted_eps).
Return on average equity was -66.2331% (calculations.json:return_on_average_equity).
Debt to equity was not stated in the supplied filings because the required inputs were unavailable.
Free cash flow was $906,384.00 (calculations.json:free_cash_flow).

The release reported $2.79 million of cash and cash equivalents and a $5.35 million working-capital deficit at September 30, 2026 (exhibit-99-1.txt:124). It also reported $6.54 million of cash used in operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 (exhibit-99-1.txt:124). These post-FY figures show that the positive FY 2025 free-cash-flow result did not continue through the first nine months of 2026.

The course owner-cash-flow formula and the price comparison appear in the saved investor worksheet. The worksheet, rather than this agent narrative, controls the live release view.

# Future Developments and Strategic Risks

The filing states that the company requires additional capital to meet its obligations and operating needs (exhibit-99-1.txt:79). At September 30, 2026, aggregate current and long-term loans payable and related interest were $4.98 million (exhibit-99-1.txt:125). The same release reported total liabilities of $22.78 million and stockholders' equity of $8.69 million (exhibit-99-1.txt:127; exhibit-99-1.txt:129).

The next filing should be checked for three items: operating cash use, the working-capital deficit, and binding evidence that the Suniva merger conditions were satisfied. The present filing leaves the amount and terms of required additional capital not known.

# Investment Recommendation

This agent report does not issue a Buy, Hold, or Sell recommendation. The live worksheet supplies a reproducible `more` or `less` view against the official $1.71 per-share close on November 20, 2026 (manifest.json:price; manifest.json:price_date). Its deciding number, liquidity result, and human conviction rule must all agree before publication.
